title: Handing Back Lapsed Subsidy Funding on a Micro Market Settlement Invoice
content:
Money left in a micro market subsidy funding lot that has run out of time is given back to the client of the Unattended Micro Market Program against the settlement invoice for the period. The credit is set against the named invoice, carries the settlement period it is allowed in, and carries no kiosk at all, because it answers funding rather than kiosk time.

## A condition on the amount handed back

The credit handed back for a lapsed funding lot is fixed only after the monthly settlement charge for the period the market stood shut stands on the agreement. While no monthly settlement charge for that closed period stands on the agreement, the credit is not yet fixed.

## Allowing the credit

The tool `issue_lapsed_funding_credit_131d77d2` hands the funding back. It is an agent-side tool: the desk unlocks it and then calls it, one call adding a single service credit posting to the agreement's ledger against the named settlement invoice.

### Parameters

- `market_agreement_id` — the reference number identifying the micro market agreement being credited, as returned by the micro market agreement lookup.
- `invoice_reference` — the settlement invoice the credit is set against, written as INV-MK- followed by 6 digits exactly as it is printed on the invoice. An empty value is not accepted.
- `service_period` — the settlement period the credit is allowed in, written as YYYY-MM with no other text. An empty value is not accepted.
- `lapsed_lot_credit_usd` — the amount to hand back, in USD to 2 decimal places, rounded to the nearest cent at the point of booking, a figure falling exactly on the half-cent going to the nearest even cent. A negative value is not accepted.

### Return

A single confirmation sentence in plain text, carrying the reference number minted for the new credit posting, the invoice it was set against, and the amount allowed in USD to two decimal places. Receiving that sentence means the credit stands against the invoice; no other outcome is reported.

## The effect on the client's account

Afterwards the client sees the credit against that invoice and owes that much less on the agreement.
